items.description: Trademark journal watch for India: finds new marks that look or sound like yours and gives the 4-month opposition deadline.

match-found.eventDescription: Charged per new similar mark delivered. Primary event.

watch-check.eventDescription: Charged once per run, after the input is valid.

mark-watched.eventDescription: Charged per watched mark and newly checked Journal.

journal-entry-exported.eventDescription: Charged per Journal entry delivered in export mode.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).

items.title: J-PlatPat Japan Patent & Trademark Crawler
items.name: j-platpat-patent-crawler
items.description: Search Japanese patents, utility models, trademarks and designs from J-PlatPat, the Japan Patent Office database. Returns titles, applicants, inventors, FI/IPC codes, claims, abstracts, filing dates and grant status.

orbtop-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory.
